learner_operation: Translate an already upper-triangular 3x3 system into an augmented matrix, eliminate entries above the third pivot using row 3, then above the second pivot using row 2, and identify the unique RREF or solution among five radio choices.

fixed_features.feature: Already-echelon nonsingular 3x3 system in x,y,z order
fixed_features.justification: Target KP and tutorial f74e6075-9c2a-5495-ab21-470711559f2a prescribe backward elimination of three pivots.

fixed_features.feature: Unit pivots and two/three integer elimination steps in practice
fixed_features.justification: All captured practice questions have unit pivots. q-131586 and q-131588 demonstrate skipped zero entries; restricting workload to the observed easy practice is defensible. Broader introduction includes pivot scaling.
All 14 source question banks use this response contract. Canonical e-4709 is fieldless and replay-only.

coverage.case: Restored q-20589 and q-20598 role/mask cross product
coverage.result: 2 profiles × 5 roles × 4 masks; all 40 unique records survive. Twelve unchanged-profile regression items also survive.

coverage.case: Fresh sampler and exact runner batch
coverage.result: 28/28 random and 5/5 runner records survive. Batch roles 0/1/3; masks [1,1,0] and [0,1,1]; four profiles and distinct non-sign-only systems. Small pool need not exhaust all eligible cases.

counterfactuals.change: For text/RREF/vector, hold A, complete bank, seed, shift and scale fixed; switch solution role 0 to 1 and derive RHS.
counterfactuals.expected: Displayed RHS, final result and accepted candidate change; old answer rejected.
counterfactuals.observed: All three pairs satisfy exact visible-equation math and every displayed operation; native grader rejects old answer and accepts new answer; screenshots inspected.
counterfactuals.justification: RHS is relevant evidence determining the unique solution, while the source correct candidate is incidental.

counterfactuals.change: Preserve solution and bank; negate off-diagonal coefficients [2,-3,1] and recompute RHS.
counterfactuals.expected: Equations and elimination operations change while accepted solution triple remains unchanged.
counterfactuals.observed: All three shapes preserve mathematical response and native acceptance, with changed prompts, row operations, matrices and rendered explanations. UUIDs and positions may change.
counterfactuals.justification: Different upper triangular systems can encode the same solution; the particular coefficient representation is irrelevant to which bank triple is correct.

counterfactuals.change: Change only task-item ID from 4 to 1 for the same normalized vector question.
counterfactuals.expected: Answer and explanation preserved; visible ordering may change.
counterfactuals.observed: Actual UI moves correct choice from first to third, defeating the apparent choose-first vector subgroup cue without changing content or grader key.
counterfactuals.justification: Task identity has no mathematical role; actual UI includes it in choice ordering.
